observation.subject: GET /api/bank-accounts
observation.sentence: `GET /api/bank-accounts`: warm median 4.4 ms over 26 requests; Handler, other work 58 %, Other filters 15 %, Response write 13 %. Median CPU 4.4 ms and 268 KB allocated per request. First request 3.5 ms (cold).
whatToCheck: Most of the time is in the handler outside recorded calls: run Profile resources to see the route's hottest frames.
Open the slowest exemplar request in Live Activity to see its timeline.
limitations: 12 warm requests were answered 401 or 403 before reaching a handler BootUI marks, as security filters do when they reject a request, so they are left out of the phases.
observation.unlistedReason: Its warm median is under 20 ms, and authorization takes under 20 % of its time and under 50 decisions a request, so it is not prominent.
